Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL1614421. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, and to compound_structures on molregno (inner join). Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL1614421, standard_value not null, and standard_relation '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
